import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen_big
import analyze as A
import z3

seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 3
rng = random.Random(seed)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=False)
inst = A._parse_request(req)
m = A.Model(inst)
t0=time.time(); k = m.find_k(); print('k=%s %.2f' % (k, time.time()-t0), flush=True)
t0=time.time(); m.enter_F(k); print('enter_F %.2f' % (time.time()-t0), flush=True)

orig = z3.Solver.check
def timed_check(self, *a, **kw):
    t0=time.time(); r = orig(self, *a, **kw); dt=time.time()-t0
    if dt > 0.2:
        print('    check %.2fs -> %s' % (dt, r), flush=True)
    return r
z3.Solver.check = timed_check

s = 1; e = 3
t0=time.time()
lo = m._minimize(m.n[s][e], m.nlo[s][e])
print('min n1_3 = %d (%.2f s) boxlo=%d' % (lo, time.time()-t0, m.nlo[s][e]), flush=True)
t0=time.time()
hi = m._maximize(m.n[s][e], m.nhi[s][e])
print('max n1_3 = %d (%.2f s) boxhi=%d' % (hi, time.time()-t0, m.nhi[s][e]), flush=True)
EOF
(timeout 170 python3 -u prof1.py 3 > prof1.log 2>&1; echo exit=$? >> prof1.log) & sleep 60; cat /workspace/scratch/prof1.log
